levels.title: Level 1.1: Neural Traversal
levels.objective: Perform an Inorder Traversal to extract the neural sequence.
levels.hint: Inorder visits left branch, root pod, then right branch.

levels.title: Level 1.2: Neural Reconstruction
levels.objective: Reconstruct the binary tree from traversal blueprints.
levels.hint: Use the Preorder + Inorder sequences to rebuild the hive.

levels.title: Level 1.3: Hive Metrics
levels.objective: Calculate and verify Tree Height and Diameter.
levels.hint: Height measures vertical levels; diameter measures the longest path.

levels.title: Level 1.4: Synaptic Convergence (LCA)
levels.objective: Locate the Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) and path between pods.
levels.hint: Find the deepest shared ancestral pod between branches.

levels.title: Level 1.5: Bilateral Reflection
levels.objective: Invert the hive structure using Tree Mirroring.
levels.hint: Swaps left and right children recursively across the trunk.

levels.title: Level 1.6: Neural Propagation
levels.objective: Perform a Level Order Traversal to synchronize all neural pods.
levels.hint: Visit nodes level by level, moving from left to right. Use a queue to process each level.

levels.title: Level 2.1: Search Heist
levels.objective: Search for target pod 60 in the BST using binary search comparisons.
levels.hint: Keys smaller go left; keys larger go right.

levels.title: Level 2.2: Stash Loot
levels.objective: Insert key 45 into the BST at the correct leaf position.
levels.hint: Trace comparisons to find the empty NULL slot.

levels.title: Level 2.3: Steal and Collapse
levels.objective: Delete leaf (20), one-child (60), and two-child (50) nodes across 3 stages.
levels.hint: Identify each deletion case. For two children, swap with inorder successor 60.

levels.title: Level 2.4: Range Raid
levels.objective: Execute Range Query [30, 65] and prune non-overlapping subtrees.
levels.hint: Branches outside the range boundaries are bypassed (20 and 80 pruned).

levels.title: Level 2.5: Boss: The Lazy Architect
levels.objective: Insert sorted sequence into BST and observe degeneration into a corridor.
levels.hint: Sorted insertions form a chain, destroying logarithmic efficiency.

levels.title: Level 3.1: Read the Badges
levels.objective: Identify all unbalanced nodes (|BF| > 1) in the vault.
levels.hint: Inspect badges: green is balanced (-1, 0, +1), red violates AVL invariant.

levels.title: Level 3.2: Single Rotations (LL & RR)
levels.objective: Repair LL and RR imbalances using single rotations.
levels.hint: LL requires Right rotation; RR requires Left rotation.

levels.title: Level 3.3: Double Rotations (LR & RL)
levels.objective: Identify and repair LR and RL imbalances using double rotations.
levels.hint: LR is Left-Right double rotation; RL is Right-Left double rotation.

levels.title: Level 3.4: Auto Mode and Prediction
levels.objective: Predict which rotation will occur before each insertion, then watch auto-rebalance.
levels.hint: Trace insertion path to determine if BF reaches +2 or -2.

levels.title: Level 3.5: Boss: Order-Statistic Heist
levels.objective: Repair the unbalanced BST, then steal the 3rd largest treasure in O(log N).
levels.hint: Balance RR at 50, then use subtreeSize to navigate to the 3rd largest node.

levels.title: Level 4.1: Activate the Vault
levels.objective: Build a valid Max Heap from raw elements using bottom-up construction.
levels.hint: Inspect each parent bottom-up; compare with children and swap with the larger child.

levels.title: Level 4.2: Repair the Security Locks
levels.objective: Execute Sift-down (Round A) and Sift-up (Round B) to restore heap mechanism.
levels.hint: Sift down root 4 with larger child; then sift up new treasure 12 to root.

levels.title: Level 4.3: Extract the Greatest Treasure
levels.objective: Repeatedly extract the root maximum and repair remaining heap with sift-down.
levels.hint: Swap root with last active element, shrink heap size, and sift down new root.

levels.title: Level 4.4: Race Against the Guards
levels.objective: Complete 4 extraction/heapify iterations before the alarm threshold triggers lockdown.
levels.hint: Work efficiently: each extraction requires root/last swap and sift-down.

levels.title: Level 4.5: Final Vault Boss
levels.objective: Execute independent full Heap Sort: Phase A build, Phase B extract/sort, Phase C validate.
levels.hint: Build max heap bottom-up, then perform repeated extractions until array is sorted.

levels.title: Level 4.6: Heap Warmup
levels.objective: Build a compact max heap from the supplied chamber values.
levels.hint: Start from the final parent and work upward.

levels.title: Level 4.7: Sift Repair Drill
levels.objective: Repair the disturbed heap using the required sift decisions.
levels.hint: Choose the larger child during each downward repair.

levels.title: Level 4.8: Extraction Drill
levels.objective: Extract the greatest values while restoring heap order.
levels.hint: After promoting the final value, sift it down.

levels.title: Level 4.9: Alarm Extraction Race
levels.objective: Complete the configured extraction route before the alarm fills.
levels.hint: Each valid extraction must preserve the max-heap property.

levels.title: Level 4.10: Sorting Vault
levels.objective: Complete the configured heap-sort decision route.
levels.hint: The sorted area grows from the right side of the array.
